_note: The Pixel's capabilities as the app declares them (android/app/src/main/java/com/aaditpani/nora/phone/*.kt). Evals register these so routing and the intent prompt look as they do with the phone connected. A manifest the hub saved from a real connection (nora_device_manifests.json) takes precedence.

capabilities.name: device.status
capabilities.description: The user's phone: battery level, whether it is charging, network (Wi-Fi or mobile data) and ringer mode

capabilities.name: phone.notify
capabilities.description: Show a notification on the user's phone

capabilities.name: phone.get_location
capabilities.description: Where the phone is now: coordinates and nearest address

capabilities.name: phone.media_control
capabilities.description: Whatever is playing on the phone; status says what it is

capabilities.name: phone.volume
capabilities.description: The phone's volume, media unless stream=ring

capabilities.name: phone.read_notifications
capabilities.description: The phone's notifications, newest first ("anything important?")

capabilities.name: phone.open_app
capabilities.description: Open an app on the phone by its name

capabilities.name: phone.open_url
capabilities.description: Open an http(s) link on the phone

capabilities.name: phone.dial
capabilities.description: The phone's dialler with a number filled in; the user presses call

capabilities.name: phone.set_alarm
capabilities.description: An alarm in the phone's clock, 24-hour time

capabilities.name: phone.set_timer
capabilities.description: A countdown timer on the phone

capabilities.name: phone.navigate
capabilities.description: Maps directions on the phone. Prefer navigate_to, which knows saved places

capabilities.name: phone.play_media
capabilities.description: Play a Spotify link on the phone (NORA finds it with play_on_phone)
